text:
A satellite is orbiting above the Earth’s equator. It completes one orbit of the Earth every
24 hours.
The satellite is 36000km above the surface of the Earth and the radius of the Earth is 6400km.
What is the orbital speed of the satellite?
A
2.6m/s
B
3.1km/s
C
74km/s
D
470km/s
subject: Physics
